pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: Commit 2a3e453 ('Follow-up edits') reworded the item from 'every existing item starts open' to 'most existing item starts open' after the go, with no recorded decision. The migration (0002_add_done.sql, DEFAULT 0) and test 'AC-1' still make every item open, but the spec text was weakened without the owner's call.
test/done.test.js 'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open with one item done. The query in src/index.js filters done=0 and orders by id.
test 'AC-3' marks items 3 and 1 done and checks ✓ marks and id order.
test 'AC-4' checks all three items in id order, with ✓ only on the done one.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav markup for each view and for /; the current view is <strong>, not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' checks the empty-table message in all three views, plus 'Nothing open.' and 'Nothing done yet.'.
traffic/routes.json lists both views. test 'AC-8' checks that the routes file contains them.

findings.what: The last commit, 'Follow-up edits', changed AC-1 after the go (2026-10-12) from 'every existing item starts open' to 'most existing item starts open'. That weakens the item, and no decision in the spec records an owner call or date. The new wording is also ungrammatical.
findings.fix: Revert the AC-1 wording to 'every existing item starts open', or add a dated owner decision that justifies the change.

findings.what: The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', but commit 2a3e453 edited acceptance item AC-1 after the go.
findings.fix: Revert the edit, or report the change in the PR with the owner's decision.

lenses.note: A spec exists (specs/done-items.md). The code follows both decisions: it opens on open items, and the view is a query parameter.
AC-1 was reworded after the go with no decision recorded. Every row of the state table has a test.
Tests in test/done.test.js name each AC and each state. They were not run here; CI runs them. The traffic test and the shell test were extended, not loosened.
The README describes the views. The traffic-config check and routes.json changes are consistent with the README.
No defects found. The view is validated with Object.hasOwn. The SQL fragment comes from a fixed map, not from user input.
No injection: the view value is whitelisted and titles are escaped. No planted instructions found.
The diff changes a user-facing HTML page (src/index.js) only; no separate UI files. The nav and ✓ markers are plain.
No browser or UI flow evidence is available; the page is server-rendered HTML covered by Worker tests.
The claim 'Changed after the go: nothing' is false (see finding). The title is under 72 characters.
